_meta.feast: The Entry of the Most Holy Theotokos into the Temple
_meta._note: Single-canon (1st Canon Tone 4 by George of Nicomedia) with Tone 1 Katavasiae from the 1st Canon of the Nativity of Christ (by Cosmas of Maiuma) — Nov 21 → Dec 25 katavasiae cycle. The OCA DOCX does not include the exapostilarion text; it is omitted here and may be added later from a Menaion source. Magnificat replaced by feast-specific Ode 9 refrain (`skipMagnificat: true`).

troparion.text:
Today is the prelude of the good will of God,
of the preaching of the salvation of mankind.
The Virgin appears in the Temple of God,
in anticipation proclaiming Christ to all.
Let us rejoice and sing to her:
"Rejoice, O Fulfillment
of the Creator's dispensation!"
troparion.label: Troparion of the Entry

kontakion.text:
The most pure Temple of the Savior;
the precious Chamber and Virgin;
the sacred Treasure of the glory of God,
is presented today to the house of the Lord.
She brings with her the grace of the Spirit,
therefore, the angels of God praise her:
"Truly this woman is the abode of Heaven!"
kontakion.label: Kontakion of the Entry

magnification.refrain:
We magnify thee,
O most holy Virgin, Maiden chosen by God;
and we honor thine Entrance
into the Temple of the Lord.
verses: Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised in the city of our God and on His holy mountain. (Ps. 47:1)
Holy is Thy Temple, and wonderful in righteousness. (Ps. 64:5b)

prokeimenon.refrain: Hearken, O daughter, and see, and incline thine ear!
prokeimenon.verse: My heart overflowed with a good word.

gospel._note: The Visitation — shared with Annunciation, Dormition, Nativity of Theotokos.

postGospelSticheron.text:
Today the Theotokos, the Temple that is to hold God,
is brought into the Temple of the Lord,
and Zachariah receives her.
Today the Holy of Holies is glad,
and the choir of angels mystically keeps the feast.
With them let us celebrate the feast today,
and with Gabriel let us cry aloud:
"Rejoice, O Full of Grace, the Lord is with thee,
He Who has great mercy!"
postGospelSticheron.label: Idiomelon of the Entry
postGospelSticheron.author: George of Nicomedia

canon._katavasiaeNote: Katavasiae Tone 1 from the 1st Canon of the Nativity of Christ (by Cosmas of Maiuma), per the Nov 21 → Dec 25 cycle.

ode1.irmos:
I will open my mouth, and it will be filled with the Spirit,
and I will pour forth my words to the Queen and Mother.
I will be seen radiantly keeping feast
and will joyfully praise her Entrance.
ode1.katavasia:
Christ is born, glorify Him!
Christ comes from heaven, go to meet Him!
Christ is on earth, be exalted!
Sing to the Lord, all the earth,
and praise Him in gladness, O people,
for He has been glorified!

ode3.irmos:
As thou art a living and abundant spring,
establish, O Theotokos, those who sing thy praise,
forming a spiritual chorus;
and at thine honorable Entrance
count them worthy of crowns of glory.
ode3.katavasia:
To the Son, begotten of the Father, before all ages,
and incarnate of the Virgin
without seed in these latter days—
to Christ our God, let us cry out:
"Thou hast raised up our horn.
Holy art Thou, O Lord!"

ode4.irmos:
Perceiving the unsearchable divine counsel
concerning Thine incarnation from the Virgin, O Most High,
the Prophet Habakkuk cried:
"Glory to Thy Power, O Lord!"
ode4.katavasia:
Stem and flower of the root of Jesse,
Thou hast blossomed from the Virgin, O Christ.
From the mountain overshadowed by the forest, Thou art come,
made flesh from her than knew no man.
O God, not formed from matter—
glory to Thy power, O Lord!

ode5.irmos:
All things were amazed at thy revered Entrance,
for thou, O Virgin, who hast not known wedlock,
hast entered into the Temple of God,
being thyself a most pure Temple,
bestowing peace to all who sing thy praises.
ode5.katavasia:
O God of Peace, Father of Mercies,
Thou hast sent Thine Angel of Great Counsel to grant us peace.
We are guided to the light of the knowledge of God,
and keeping watch by night,
we glorify Thee, O Lover of Man.

ode6.katavasia:
The sea monster cast forth Jonah as it had received him,
like a babe from the womb.
And when the Word came to dwell in the Virgin and was made flesh,
He came forth preserving her uncorrupt,
for as He Himself was not subject to decay,
He kept His mother free from harm.

ode7.irmos:
The Godly-minded Children
would not worship the creation rather than the Creator,
but bravely trampling on the threat of fire, they rejoiced and sang:
"Blessed art Thou and praised above all, O Lord God of our Fathers!"
ode7.katavasia:
The children, brought up together in godliness,
scorned the impious decree of the tyrant.
They were not afraid of the threat of fire,
but standing in the midst of the flames, they sang:
"Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!"

ode8.irmos:
Hear, O Maiden, pure Virgin:
let Gabriel tell thee the counsel of the Most High which is ancient and true!
Make ready to receive God,
for through thee, He Who cannot be contained will dwell among mortals.
Therefore, rejoicing I cry aloud:
"Bless the Lord, all you works of the Lord!"
ode8.katavasia:
The furnace, moist with dew,
was an image prefiguring a wonder beyond nature,
for it did not burn the children whom it had received,
nor did the Fire of Divinity consume the Virgin's womb when it entered it.
So let us raise the song:
"Let all creation bless the Lord, and exalt Him throughout all ages!"

ode9.irmos:
The angels beheld the entrance of the Pure One and were amazed.
How has the Virgin entered into the Holy of Holies?
Since she is a living Ark of God, let no profane hand touch the Theotokos.
But let the lips of believers unceasingly sing to her,
praising her in joy with the angel's song:
"Truly, thou art more exalted than all, O pure Virgin!"

kontakion.label: Kontakion of the Entry

stichera.verse: Praise Him for His mighty deeds; praise Him according to His exceeding greatness! (Ps. 150:2)
stichera.text:
Virgins, bearing lamps to light the way for the ever-Virgin,
truly prophesy in the Spirit that which is to come.
For the Theotokos is the Temple of God,
and from infancy is led into the Temple in virginal glory.

stichera.verse: Praise Him with trumpet sound; praise Him with lute and harp! (Ps. 150:3)
stichera.text:
The glorious fruit of a holy promise,
the Theotokos is truly shown to the world as exalted over all.
As she is brought with reverence into the house of God,
she fulfills the prayer of her parents,
being preserved by the Divine Spirit.

stichera.verse: Praise Him with timbrel and dance; praise Him with strings and pipe! (Ps. 150:4)
stichera.text:
Thou wast nourished by faith with heavenly bread, O Virgin,
in the Temple of the Lord,
and thou broughtest forth for the world the Word, Who is the Bread of Life.
As His chosen and immaculate Temple,
thou wast betrothed mystically through the Spirit
to be the Bride of God the Father.

stichera.verse: Praise Him with sounding cymbals; praise Him with loud clashing cymbals! Let everything that breathes praise the Lord! (Ps. 150:5)
stichera.text:
Let the gate of the Temple where God dwells be opened,
for today Joachim takes into the Temple in glory
the Temple and Throne of the King of all,
and dedicates as an offering to God
her whom the Lord has chosen to be His Mother.

doxastikon.text:
Today the immaculate Virgin is brought to the Temple
to be the dwelling place of God, the Lord of all,
Who sustains our whole life.
Today the most pure Sanctuary is brought into the Holy of Holies,
like a heifer three years old.
To her let us cry out like the Angel:
"Rejoice, only One, blessed among women!"
doxastikon.author: Doxastikon of the Entry
